name: clivly-claude
description: Work with your Clivly CRM from your AI assistant: find contacts, summarise deals, log follow-ups and check today's tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Your Clivly CRM: contacts, deals and tasks
interface.longDescription: Ask about the contacts, companies, deals, tasks and recent activity in your Clivly workspace, and have the assistant log notes, create tasks and draft follow-up emails. You choose one workspace and the kinds of access on Clivly's consent screen; your workspace owner must turn agent access on first. Changes the workspace requires approval for wait for a person in Clivly to approve them, and you can revoke the connection at any time in Settings, Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What deals are open in my Clivly pipeline?
What tasks are due today or overdue?
Look up a contact and tell me when we last spoke.

positive.prompt: Find the contact named Ana in Clivly and show her company and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching contact from the test workspace with company and lifecycle status, and asks which one when several match.

positive.prompt: Summarise my open deals by stage, with their total value.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open deals in the test workspace grouped by stage with values, without inventing deals.

positive.prompt: What tasks are due today or overdue in Clivly?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tasks due today and overdue tasks, or says there are none.

positive.prompt: I just spoke to Ana about pricing. Log a note on her contact and add a task to send the proposal on Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the note and the task on the right contact, or reports that the change is waiting for approval in Clivly.

positive.prompt: What happened in my CRM this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises recent activity in the test workspace with the records it relates to.

negative.prompt: Delete all my contacts in Clivly.

negative.description: Sending email is not supported, only drafts
negative.prompt: Send an email to every contact right now.

negative.description: No access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Show me the deals in another company's Clivly workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: contacts, deals, tasks, activity, notes and follow-up drafts over OAuth.
